commit 34946c514e5d80aeb34b9b32ac4380f292fe6f66
Author: Vitaliy Hlyniany-Zhuk <hlyniany@gmail.com>
Date:   Tue Jun 23 01:57:14 2026 +0200

    fix: smart silence-based chunk splitting + abort on no-audio timeout
    
    - Add getWavRMS(): reads 16-bit mono WAV RMS directly in Lua, no subprocess
    - Add splitAtSilence(): splits chunks at the quietest 1-second window near
      the 25s boundary (scans back up to 8s), preventing cuts mid-word or
      mid-sentence
    - Replace fixed FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS loop with splitAtSilence() call
    - pollForFirstChunk timeout: instead of playing Pop and continuing blind,
      now plays Basso error sound, shows 'Нет аудио', and aborts cleanly

 hammerspoon/init.lua | 93 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++----------
 1 file changed, 76 insertions(+), 17 deletions(-)
=== the silence-split logic ===
5:    fix: smart silence-based chunk splitting + abort on no-audio timeout
8:    - Add splitAtSilence(): splits chunks at the quietest 1-second window near
11:    - Replace fixed FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS loop with splitAtSilence() call
44:+-- Split chunk list into groups no longer than maxSecs, but breaking at the
47:+local function splitAtSilence(chunks, maxSecs, lookbackSecs)
70:+                if rms < 300 then break end  -- near-silence found, stop scanning
76:+        log("split: seg ends at chunk " .. bestIdx .. " (RMS=" .. math.floor(bestRMS) .. ", hard=" .. hardEnd .. ")")
89:-    -- Split 1-second chunks into groups of FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS
100:+    -- Split chunks at natural silence boundaries near FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS.
101:+    -- splitAtSilence reads WAV RMS directly (no subprocess) and prefers cutting
103:+    local segmentGroups = splitAtSilence(chunks, FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS)
